175566.overview: Tyrann. - Here is a role-playing adventure game that takes you to the medieval village of Golanur. Six characters, created at the start of the game, will act under your orders. Your team formed, it must be armed and protected. Send your characters one by one to the stall. Their fortune varies according to their caste: it is sometimes necessary to combine the money of two of them to arm a third. As for the adventure, two levels of play are available: on side A of the tape, a nine-level maze will allow you to train and meet monsters, each one more deadly than the other. When the team has reached, on average, the eleventh level of experience, the B-side will plunge them into the secret of Tyrann, the real goal of the game.In a labyrinth much larger than the previous one, you will then discover new spells whose meaning will have to be penetrated. Don't let your hit points decrease too much. The great alchemist can easily get you back on your feet but his prices are up to the service he provides you. A captivating game.

175908.overview:
X208 wing commander. In training, attack! But where have they gone? Central computer assessment?
All ships have been destroyed. You remain alone in control for the freedom of galaxy... Only solution: shoot down the admiral ship protected by dozens of ships subordinate but extremely dangerous.

To make matters worse, your fuel is limited and they have launched after you a saucer with a magnetic head which spots you and chases you. 

Given the situation, your chances of survival are 0.000001 per thousand (remaining very optimistic!).

423540.overview:
Them: A Paranoid Fantasy is an arcade action game divided into five stages, each with completely different gameplay.

Stage 1: The player controls his character from a top down perspective and has to collect two visas and an exit pass to unlock the exit while at the same time avoiding the bad guys that move around. Contact with enemies or walls will lead to a life lost although a shield can be used for protection.

Stage 2: Five blocks of different sizes move back and forth across the screen at different speeds. The player has to make a stack of the blocks by pressing a key when the lowest block is directly beneath the block above it. They will then lock onto each other.

Stage 3: The player is located in the middle of the screen and is surrounded by demons that shoot bombs toward him. The player has to avoid these and kill the demons with his entropy bolt.

Stage 4: The player finds himself on a conveyor belt leading to a doomsday machine. On both sides of it are demons that run the belt. To stop the belt the player shoots up and down at the demons as they move past him.

Stage 5: The player has to match the tops and bottoms of bones. At the top of the screen are eight faces that the bones belong to. When moving the cursor over a bone the face of it's owner will turn yellow. The player then has to remember which bones belong to which face and match accordingly.

The stages can be played in sequence and will then restart at a higher level when all stages have been completed but it's also possible to play each stage on its own.

465154.overview:
Trouble in Store is a fast action arcade game which takes place in a department store known as Harridges. You play the part of the manager of the store.

The nightmare is that some of the goods being sold come alive and get in the way of the manager as he moves around. You must avoid coming close to anything that is moving, though you might find that you can use moving objects as ledges on occasions - this is living very dangerously! If you get too close to a moving object (p.s. the till can also be dangerous at the wrong time!) you will lose one of your four lives. Extra lives are awarded for every 10,000 points.

The manager must first collect the key to the till that is located on each floor, and only then go to the till to collect the day's takings. Once the till has been touched, the manager must leave the floor by escaping through the ceiling.
